title: Learned Controllers for Agile Quadrotors in Pursuit-Evasion Games
abstract: arXiv:2506.02849v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study one-versus-one (1v1) quadrotor pursuit-evasion, where a pursuer and an evader are trained with reinforcement learning (RL). Direct adversarial RL tends to be unstable because opponent policies change during training, causing non-stationarity, forgetting, and strategy cycling. We propose Asynchronous Multi-Stage Population-Based training, inspired by Policy-Space Response Oracles (PSRO). Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) trains responses against previously learned opponents held fixed during each stage. The uniform variant, AMSPB-U, samples opponents equally, while AMSPB-P combines hard prioritized fictitious self-play (PFSP) with uniform exploration to emphasize currently difficult opponents. In cross-evaluations against learned opponents, both variants improve pursuit-evasion balance over latest-opponent training. translated_title: 追逃博弈中敏捷四旋翼飞行器的学习型控制器
translated_abstract: 我们研究一对一（1v1）四旋翼追逃博弈问题，其中追捕者与逃避者均通过强化学习（RL）进行训练。直接的对抗性强化学习往往不稳定，因为对手策略在训练过程中不断变化，导致非平稳性、遗忘和策略循环等问题。我们提出了一种受策略空间响应预言机（PSRO）启发的异步多阶段基于种群的训练方法（Asynchronous Multi-Stage Population-Based training）。该方法使用近端策略优化（PPO）在每个阶段针对保持固定的先前学习到的对手进行响应策略训练。均匀变体 AMSPB-U 均等地采样对手，而 AMSPB-P 则将硬优先级虚拟自我博弈（PFSP）与均匀探索相结合，以重点关注当前难以应对的对手。在针对已学习对手的交叉评估中，两种变体相比仅针对最新对手训练的方法都改善了追逃博弈的平衡性。AMSPB-P 取得了最高的得分，同时保持了对早期策略的应对能力。在各种不同的起始位……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种受PSRO启发的异步多阶段基于种群的强化学习训练方法（AMSPB），通过在各阶段针对固定的历史对手训练响应策略，解决了四旋翼追逃博弈中直接对抗强化学习的不稳定问题，其中结合优先级虚拟自我博弈的AMSPB-P变体在保持对早期策略竞争力的同时取得了最优的追逃平衡表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Asynchronous Multi-Stage Population-Based training method (AMSPB) inspired by PSRO, which trains response policies in stages against fixed historical opponents to overcome the instability of direct adversarial RL in quadrotor pursuit-evasion games, with the prioritized variant AMSPB-P achieving the best pursuit-evasion balance while remaining competent against earlier strategies.
